batch: Classify four works from publisher, institutional and museum evidence
policy: These are work-scope judgments only. They do not certify complete object extraction, endorse readings, resolve identities or authenticity, or change text and media rights.

entries.basis: The Hebrew University abstract describes a comparative study of legal formulae in bowls, rabbinic literature and archaeological divorce documents rather than an object edition.
The official museum record identifies one bowl, inventory 010895, describes its fertility-and-childbirth incantation and biblical citations, and points specifically to Bhayro's article.
The British Museum record for 1957,0925.1 says Levene and Bohak first published that bowl in this article and describes the deities and toponyms it analyzes.
The Oxford University Press abstract states that the article publishes one new eight-line Iraq Museum bowl, IM 212092.
